profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Front-End at LiveOne Media, Inc.
profile.summary:
I grew up loving taking things apart and finding out how they worked.  When I found out about programming I felt compelled to do the same thing! During college is where I found the passion for learning how to code and make things that can benefit myself and others. I was apart of a computer security group where we would learn about different vulnerabilities in different systems and document our findings for awareness and to teach others.  After college I started working for a web hosting company where I was able to get a deeper understanding of how to help people create the vision they were looking for in their website.  Creating something reality from an idea is the greatest form of accomplishment in my eyes and is what pushes me to dive deeper into the programming world.

Here you can view my portfolio: https://anthonybo.com

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Front-End
positions.description:
○ Setup various micro sites for different social events that we have hosted using ReactJS.
○ Created a meet and greet web application to allow users to have a one and one with talent using PeerJS to take advantage of WebRTC technology for supporting multiple web calls and chat behavior.
○ Developed socialgloves.livexlive.com with React and AWS to allow specialized traffic requirements for a massive PPV event. The site utilizes Lambdas for network calls for data functionality.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
○	Develop software for locker kiosk using NodeJS & Angular 7.
○	Maintain & develop software for mobile application using Ionic 3 and Cordova 8.
○	Worked in an AGILE environment using Jira for ticket management & including morning standups.
○	Created script for easily switching environment based on the type of kiosk we require.
○	Worked with the different kiosk hardware which runs on a Centos OS.
○	Develop reusable components in Angular 7 used throughout the different kiosks.
○	Worked in tangent with the web portal and API teams for a fluid team atmosphere. 
○	Created custom flows and design for clientele that required special functionality.
○	Utilized KnexJS to create and modify the locker database schema.

positions.title: Web Developer Internship
positions.description:
○	Solo-project built with ReactJS frontend and a NodeJS backend utilizing MySQL.
○	Collaborate with developers on ideation, solving problems, and troubleshooting issues
○	Developed app to display Whole Foods locations and cross reference them with user input to display areas that include those places.
○	Created wireframe layout and storyboard with Figma for cohesive user interface.
